name: findmy-location
description: The user's current location as context, read from the macOS Find My app's device list — the phone, or a fallback device — with place label, address, distance from this Mac and how fresh it is

primary_device.title: Primary device
primary_device.description: Device name exactly as Find My's device list shows it, usually the phone

fallback_device.title: Fallback device
fallback_device.description: Device read when the primary one has no fresh location, such as a watch; leave empty for none
